findings.evidence: Radix FocusScope handleKeyDown (node_modules/@radix-ui/react-focus-scope/dist/index.mjs:120-136) does not check event.defaultPrevented and moves focus to the first element when the focused element is the last tabbable one.
findings.impact: No impact today: in the game memo, expense detail and request modals the memo textarea is followed by buttons. If a memo textarea ever becomes the last tabbable element in a dialog, Tab would insert a tab and also jump focus to the first element.
findings.recommendation: Keep a button after memo textareas in dialogs, or call event.stopPropagation() after preventDefault() in insertTabOnKeyDown.

findings.evidence: The tab is inserted by replacing the controlled value through setValue instead of a native text insertion.
findings.impact: Browser undo (Ctrl+Z) may not revert the inserted tab as a separate step, consistent with other programmatic value changes in the app.
findings.recommendation: Accept as is; revisit only if users report undo issues.

findings.evidence: Schedule memo display changed from whitespace-pre-line to whitespace-pre-wrap as required by the acceptance criteria.
findings.impact: Consecutive and leading spaces in existing schedule memos are now shown as typed instead of collapsed. Intended side effect.
